painpoints.text: Seed fabro-f677 description lists fix direction 2 (bullet list below the table) that directly contradicts its own acceptance criterion 1 (single table row per key). Ambiguous specs invite reviewer ping-pong; seed descriptions with multiple fix directions should mark which directions are compatible with the acceptance criteria (evidence: sd show fabro-f677, run 01M1MMK5C6B313SY70Y2EPKE82 report).

observations: fabro-f677 is Low priority but explicitly named by the goal, so it was claimed ahead of higher-priority unrelated seeds.

Bug is narrow and local: only `append_filtered_context_table` in `lib/components/fabro-workflow/src/handler/llm/preamble.rs` needs changes; `format_value` and `append_filtered_context` must stay multi-line-capable.
Existing test coverage for this table exists at `preamble.rs` line ~1685 (`## Current context` assertion) — a good anchor for the new unit test.

First two test reruns after a passing-source edit ran a stale binary and failed with the old assertion message; `touch` on preamble.rs forced a rebuild and the test passed. Anyone seeing a nextest failure whose panic text doesn't match current source should force a rebuild before debugging.

painpoints.text: Evidence capture for run 01M1NK4V3YG3AQAMEKDJ6V471F embedded the WRONG seed spec: the 'in-progress seed spec (authoritative)' section and the header's claim-base seed both named fabro-3224 (the HANDOFF seed) instead of fabro-f677, the seed actually under review. I had to fall back to the preamble brief plus direct tool verification of preamble.rs and a focused test run. Fix idea: the evidence.nu capture should resolve the seed spec from the run's current in-progress seed, not from whatever seed the claim-base commit last touched.

observations: Verified the full +69/-2 diff in the blob against the f677 spec: sanitize_table_cell (newlines→' / ', blanks collapsed, '|' escaped post-join so order is safe) wired only into the plain-value path of append_filtered_context_table; large-value path, format_value, bullet-list path, and context store untouched — all acceptance criteria met.

Re-ran the focused test summary_high_table_renders_multiline_value_as_single_row (PASS 1/1) and read preamble.rs on disk to confirm it matches the captured diff; gate treated as green per tester stage.

painpoints.text: The closeout script for run 01M1NK4V3YG3AQAMEKDJ6V471F closed the wrong seed: its output said 'closeout: closed fabro-3224' (the HANDOFF seed) while fabro-f677 — the seed actually implemented, gated, and approved — stayed in_progress. This matches the evidence-stage painpoint about seed resolution falling back to the claim-base commit's last-touched seed. Fix idea: `nu .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/closeout.nu` must resolve the seed to close from the run's current_seed_id context value, never from git history; until fixed, every approved seed risks silently staying open.

observations: Re-claimed fabro-f677 as verification-only after confirming on disk that `sanitize_table_cell` exists at preamble.rs:346 and is wired at :379; prior tester and reviewer stages both succeeded, so this cycle should be a no-diff verification pass whose only real purpose is letting closeout close the correct seed.
fabro-3224 was closed by the misdirected closeout; `sd ready` shows 41 other open seeds, so the tracker is healthy apart from the stale f677 status.
